summary: Orion S.A. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce the declaration of an interim dividend to be paid in Q4 2026. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1 and was signed by the CFO. No price, premium, or transaction terms are provided as this is a routine dividend declaration. The announcement does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. It is a standard corporate action with no structural or regulatory complexities. What to watch: actual payment date and amount details may follow in subsequent filings.
